'''Andy McClure''' (DeckTech handle '''Solo337''') finished in the final eight of the [[2001 Decipher World Championship]] at [[FreedomCon]].<ref name="fc-forum">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=75427 SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History], forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020; players' recollection of the 2001 top 8). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="hayes-tr">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-11-at-long-last-hayes-freedomcon-trd3493/ At long last, Hayes' FreedomCon TR], Hayes Hunter, DeckTech (11 March 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016161000/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-11-at-long-last-hayes-freedomcon-trd3493/ Internet Archive]</ref> He lost in the quarterfinals to [[Brian Hunter]].<ref name="f75427-1300395">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300395#p1300395 Post by rhendon], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html#p1300395 Internet Archive]</ref>
